about: Muscle cars: a big V8 by revs, its start, stop and revs; the rest falls back to core:vehicle.
notes: v3 (vehicle round). Engine layers are 20 s beds cut to loop, played faster or slower by rpm; slot names match core:vehicle's, so a vehicle of this family is heard by them first and by core:vehicle for the rest.

prompts.text: A classic V8 muscle car idles: a deep lumpy loping rumble from the big exhaust, constant. Recorded from just outside, steady, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A V8 muscle car at low revs under load: a deep steady throaty burble, constant pitch. Recorded from just outside, steady, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A V8 muscle car at middle revs: a loud steady growling roar, constant pitch. Recorded from just outside, steady, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A V8 muscle car near its redline: a loud howling V8 roar, constant pitch. Recorded from just outside, steady, no music, no voices, quiet background.

engine/start.want: the starter and the V8 barking into life

prompts.text: A V8 muscle car is started: the starter cranks and the big engine fires with a loud bark and settles into a lumpy rumbling idle, two separate starts with long pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A V8 muscle car's engine is switched off: it shudders and dies with a last burble, three separate times with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
A V8 muscle car's engine is revved hard in neutral: a loud rising roar and a crackling burbling fall, four separate revs with pauses. Close-miked, dry, no music, no voices, quiet background.
